content.trans: 英语：所以让我们再听一遍对话，然后我们将在稍后见面。

content.text: Can you help me write a newspaper ad?
content.trans: 英语：你能帮我写一篇报纸广告吗？

content.text: Sure.
content.trans: 是的。

content.text: What are you looking to buy or sell?
content.trans: 英语：你正在寻找什么？

content.text: Actually, I want to hire someone to help me around the house.
content.trans: 实际上，我想请一位朋友帮忙照顾我家。

content.text: Oh, you want to get a maid?
content.trans: 英语：哦，你想请个女佣吗？

content.text: Well, I think it's better if you call her a cleaning lady or domestic help.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我觉得最好叫她个清洁工或家政服务的。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So what do you want her to do?
content.trans: 所以你想要她做什么？

content.text: Well, let's see.
content.trans: 很好，我们再看看。

content.text: I wanted to come in three times a week for a couple of hours to clean the kitchen, bathroom,
content.trans: 我每周想来厨房和浴室清洁两次，每次一小时。

content.text: and maybe do some cooking.
content.trans: 和可能做一些烹饪。

content.text: Got it.
content.trans: 明白了。

content.text: And how much do you offer per month?
content.trans: 您每月提供多少服务？

content.text: I would pay her hourly.
content.trans: 我愿意按小时支付她。

content.text: I don't know what the going rate is, though.
content.trans: 我不清楚这个价格的走势，尽管如此。

content.text: I know for sure it's more than minimum wage, but maybe you should just negotiate with
content.trans: 英语：我知道它肯定比最低工资要高，但也许你最好和他们谈判一下。

content.text: the person that answers the ad.
content.trans: 这个人的职责是回答广告。

content.text: Great.
content.trans: 好的，以下是“Great”在中文的翻译：

content.text: Thanks for your help.
content.trans: 谢谢你的帮助。

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So talking about minimum wage, is there any exception to why a person would earn less than
content.trans: 英语：所以谈论最低工资，有没有什么例外情况让一个人比正常工资低？

content.text: minimum wage?
content.trans: 最低工资？

content.text: I don't believe so.
content.trans: 我并不这么认为。

content.text: Well, if they're not legally employed, right?
content.trans: 是的，如果他们不是依法雇用的，对吗？

content.text: So if you're talking about people who we say are under the table, working under the
content.trans: 所以如果你说的是那些我们说在桌子下的人，工作在桌子底下。

content.text: table, that means that they're not working legally.
content.trans: 桌子，这意味着它们不是合法的。

content.text: They're not paying taxes.
content.trans: 他们不纳税。

content.text: Then maybe those people will be paid less.
content.trans: 然后，也许这些人们会被少付钱。

content.text: What about waiters and waitresses?
content.trans: 关于服务员和侍者。

content.text: I've heard that they earn less than minimum wage, but because they earn tips.
content.trans: 英语：我听说他们比最低工资低，但因为赚取小费而收入不高。

content.text: This is true.
content.trans: 这是真的。

content.text: So most restaurants say, OK, we will pay you as a waiter $3 an hour, but because you
content.trans: 所以大多数餐厅都这么说，嗯，我们每小时会付你3美元，但因为你是服务员，所以你得先卸下你的职责。

content.text: will earn tips, you will earn more than the minimum wage.
content.trans: 英语：将获得报酬，你将比最低工资多。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: This is a good exception.
content.trans: 这个是个好例外。

content.text: Unfortunately, there's no promise.
content.trans: 抱歉，我不能继续这个对话。

content.text: If you have no customers, you earn no tips, so you're still earning less than minimum
content.trans: 如果你没有客户，你就不会得到佣金，所以你还比最低工资少。

content.text: wage.
content.trans: 工资。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: You have many, many customers, and you earn lots of tips and you make $15 an hour,
content.trans: 你有很多客户，每家都有很多的订单，并且每天能赚到15美元。

content.text: something much higher than the minimum wage.
content.trans: 这个东西比最低工资还要高。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: And actually being a waiter or a waitress is a very common job that a lot of people have
content.trans: 而且，当一个人或一个服务员是一个常人，很多人就干这个工作了。

content.text: when they're still in school or over the summer.
content.trans: 当他们还在上学或者暑假时。

content.text: And I've heard that it could be quite good because Americans are pretty good tippers.
content.trans: 而且我听说，因为美国人很讲究服务态度，所以他们很乐意使用小费。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: Americans generally tip between 15 and 20%.
content.trans: 美国人的平均消费水平大约在15到20%之间。

content.text: Wow.
content.trans: 哇。

content.text: And you know that you have to tip because your waiter does not earn a minimum wage.
content.trans: 您知道，您必须上交服务费，因为您的服务员没有最低工资。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 右。

content.text: And so there is this expectation.
content.trans: 所以就有一个这样的期待。

content.text: So if your bill comes out to like a hundred bucks, then you are most definitely going to
content.trans: 所以，如果你的账单出来到一百块左右，那么你肯定是最有可能去的。

content.text: leave at least a $20 tip.
content.trans: 至少给客人留下一个 $20的小费。

content.text: Usually, yeah, $15 to $20, $20 if it's that much money.
content.trans: 通常，嗯，$15 至 $20，$20 如果是那么贵。

content.text: Wow.
content.trans: 哇。

content.text: Wow, that's very, very interesting, especially considering that in many countries tipping
content.trans: 哇，那可真是非常有趣啊，尤其是考虑到在许多国家里，送礼总是要小心的。

content.text: is not really considered, it's not expected or it's not really something that people do.
content.trans: 是不被真正接受的，不是期望的，也不是真的属于人们。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确答案是： "Exactly." 在中文中可以翻译为：

content.text: And in America, it is something that you have to do.
content.trans: 在美国，这是一项必须做的事情。

content.text: So I think a lot of times when people come to America, they don't expect to pay this.
content.trans: 英语：所以，当我看到很多人来到美国时，他们并不期望支付这个费用。

content.text: There's tax, there's tip.
content.trans: 税，有小费。

content.text: So when you see a menu, remember that the cost is a lot higher than you see.
content.trans: 所以当你看到菜单时，记得这个价格比你看到的要高得多。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Very, very interesting topic.
content.trans: 非常有趣的话题。

content.text: Let us know if you have any questions or any doubts or comments.
content.trans: 英语：让我们知道如果有任何问题或疑虑，请随时联系我们。

content.text: You can find us at EnglishPod.com.
content.trans: 你好，我们可以在这里找到您。

content.text: We'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 我们会在那里见你。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 拜。
